'''Malfosa''' was a legendary [[Sher Kar/Legends|Sher Kar]] who roamed the [[Burning Plains/Legends|Burning Plains]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. This scorpion-like beast would wipe out entire [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colonies before retreating to its lair. Uprisings were common, but ill-prepared hunters were no match for the mighty Malfosa.

==Behind the scenes==
Malfosa appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
